about_the_game:
You’ll feel like a guardian of the galaxy when you use these extraterrestrial stickers. Open new worlds through active portals and mystical symbols. Place animated stickers in space videos and see if you can get response from another galaxy.

In this set you’ll find 6 stickers.

The DLC set is compatible with Movavi Video Editor Plus 2020
